# Colorado Mountain College

> > Colorado Mountain College (CMC) is a dual-mission Hispanic-Serving Institution offering bachelor's and associate degrees across 11 campuses in Colorado's Rocky Mountains.

CMC serves eight counties with 130+ programs including outdoor recreation, veterinary technology, avalanche science, and professional photography. Students access courses through Canvas LMS and manage enrollment via the Basecamp portal.

## Key Topics

- Colorado Mountain College (CMC)
- Hispanic-Serving Institution
